factProposals.value: Sign-in is a salted scrypt password followed by a required TOTP code (RFC 6238), then a session in an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie that expires after 30 minutes idle or 8 hours.
Every login attempt is audited with IP address and time before the answer is sent; if the audit cannot be written the login is refused.
Brute force is limited per user, per address and per both; a session used from another IP or browser is ended.
PII handling is documented; retention is left as a City decision.

decisions.statement: Local accounts with authenticator codes until Active Directory is available.
decisions.rationale: this project cannot reach a directory; there is one place to plug AD in later

decisions.statement: Role headers only work when a test asks createApp for them.
decisions.rationale: nothing that starts the real system can bypass sign-in

decisions.statement: An incorrect password gets the same answer whether or not the user exists, and raises a logged alert.
decisions.rationale: does not reveal which usernames exist

limitations.statement: REQ-010 is not met: no Active Directory and no single sign-on.
No self-service password change or reset, no authenticator setup or QR codes, and no TLS in the server itself (deploy refuses to listen beyond this machine without a TLS proxy).
